topics.purpose: Define grouping-only parent Topic identity TOPIC_CI already referenced by 1 existing canonical child Topic reference occurrence(s).

metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.input_rule: CI gate evaluates exact candidate repository revision/change set.
semantics.bootstrap_rule: Root Contract Format bootstrap must succeed.
semantics.conformance_rule: Required repository conformance profile/result must pass.
semantics.readiness_rule: Lock/readiness requirements apply only where configured for affected scope.
semantics.projection_rule: Required generated projections must be current/consistent.
semantics.merge_rule: Gate pass makes change merge-eligible but does not itself define human/repository authorization to merge.
semantics.runtime_rule: CI merge eligibility never means runtime deployment.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.
